name: gstack
description: Use Garry Tan's exact Claude Code setup: 23 opinionated tools that serve as CEO, Designer, Eng Manager, Release Manager, Doc Engineer, and QA
one_liner: A free toolkit that turns one AI coding assistant into a whole pretend engineering team — a CEO, designer, QA tester, and security reviewer who each check your work before it ships.
buyer: A solo founder or first-time technical CEO who can code a feature but has no team to review, design-check, or QA it before customers see it.
business_use_cases: A solo founder uses it to get CEO-level product pushback, a design review, and a QA pass on every feature, effectively replacing three early hires he can't yet afford.
A small agency builds a 'ship like a VC-backed startup' process for client work on top of it, charging clients for the extra review rigor.
A bootcamp or accelerator uses it as the toolkit in a paid course teaching non-technical founders how to ship software with AI.

money_ideas.idea: Paid course or cohort teaching founders to run the gstack workflow, riding Garry Tan's name recognition.
Consulting retainer where an agency runs the gstack review pipeline on a client's codebase every sprint.

steal_this: Package the '/office-hours' and '/review' flow into a hosted micro-SaaS for non-technical founders who don't want to set up Claude Code themselves — charge a flat monthly fee to run their repo through it.
